reason: The comment at app/assets/stylesheets/common/base/discourse.scss:72-73 still states that the default for topic-list table cells is `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%)`, even though this patch converted both the topic-list table cells (app/assets/stylesheets/common/base/_topic-list.scss:48,55; app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/topic-list.scss:75) and the adjacent `.coldmap-*` rules (app/assets/stylesheets/common/base/discourse.scss:76,79,82) to `dark-light-choose(...)`.
